An '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' was damaged during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], having had its left [[ISD-72x deflector shield generator dome|shield generator dome]] destroyed. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], attempting to evacuate [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], put it out of commission by destroying its remaining [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] and the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] in order to create enough of an opening to escape.
